//ignore_gitignore: Honour .gitignore files (repo root + nested) while walking. .gitignore syntax supported: # comments, blank lines, ! negation, leading-slash anchoring, trailing-slash directory-only, * ? ** globs and [abc]/[a-z] character classes.
//max_line_chars: A text file with any single line longer than this is treated as minified/binary-ish and skipped (bundled JS, one-line JSON). PDF/DOCX are exempt. Set to 0 to disable.
//ui_height: Launcher window height in px (result list grows up to this).
//debounce_ms: Keystroke debounce before a search is fired, in milliseconds.
//theme: Design tokens for the launcher. Mirrors mjolnir/styles.py; change them here to re-skin the UI without touching code. shadow.alpha is 0-255 (115 ~= 0.45).
//bindings: Keyboard bindings shown in the launcher footer. 'open' opens the hit, 'reveal' selects it in Explorer, 'copy' copies the full path, 'actions' opens the quick-action menu, 'close' hides the launcher, 'reindex' re-runs the indexer. 'clipboard' is the global hotkey that swaps the launcher into clipboard history mode, 'paste' is the one-key paste inside it.
//clipboard_enabled: Run the background clipboard watcher (Alt+Shift+C or 'cb' in the search bar opens the history). Copies are detected through the Win32 clipboard sequence number, not by polling the clipboard text.
//clipboard_db: SQLite file for the clipboard history. Lives next to the index in the config directory (PLETHORA_HOME, default %USERPROFILE%\.plethora-mjolnir).
//clipboard_max_items: How many clipboard entries to keep; the oldest are trimmed whenever a new copy is recorded.
//clipboard_max_chars: Copies longer than this many characters are ignored (a whole file dump would bloat the history).
//clipboard_poll_ms: Watcher tick in milliseconds. Each tick compares one integer (the clipboard sequence number); the clipboard text is only read when that number changed.
